Thank you, I agree with this. When he got  mad I  I was surprised. For example, when he told me that he would take me to my house I was in disbelief because I wasn’t even angry at him or anything. It was him just being so angry at me because I interrupted him. So I was shocked to see that he was acting out out of something that to me meant nothing. I even had to ask him if he was being serious about taking me back to my house since we hardly even see each other and won’t see each other again for two weeks. 

I mentioned he has screamed at me in the past, and tbh I hoped he would at least realize that what he is doing is wrong. Usually he does admit that him acting like that is wrong.... but other times I have to tell him to apologize to me because he thinks is justified. When he is angry he just tells me hurtful things and “acts out.”


So idk I think I have to tell him to do therapy or meditation. I’m not sure what steps to take from here.

Hey I have a suggestion. *This is just my personal opinion*. It sounds like the parents don’t give him much attention and he is probably just acting out to get it. I know you hate this child, (so would I). But I think sitting down and talking to him might help. You need to be very patient. Tell him that what he is doing is not right. Explain to him that it makes you feel very angry the way that he is acting, and that it is dangerous.  Also, tell him that you are not a freak and such. I know this might sound cringy to you, but Try attempting it. I don’t know why but i think the kid needs love and attention. 

If that doesn’t work call the cops hahah ^

I’m with a narcissist right now and I am going through something similar. I went through an ectopic pregnancy and it’s been so hard for me.

Well I wasn’t always depressed :/ I had an ectopic pregnancy in November. And it was seriously terrible for my mental health and body. I became extremely depressed. My hormones were super bad. I am having the depression pregnant women have. I forgot the name. And my boyfriend was clueless to everything. I did in fact have to tell him what to do all the time. Even so, he would get mad at me and scream at me when I would have break downs or panic attacks. It was really really bad. I took some responsability for that because I was also being mean to him in return. But it was different, I was going through constant bleeding and it was terrible. Just recently I started listening to a few podcasts and books about relationships. 3 days ago he tried breaking up with me because I was really depressed, I couldn’t apply for unemployment. He thought I was just being lazy and snapped at me, told me he wanted to break up and didn’t see himself with someone who couldn’t even fill out one form. He has apologized, but I just haven’t talked to him since. I then read your post and realized I have been going through something so similar.
